title: Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary: Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge: Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify — Say goodbye to those aux cables. Spotify's new in-car app is here, and it's rolling out to Audi vehicles today.
